data.title: Precision, Discipline & Unity
data.content: In 2017, Gray D. Allison High School placed third in Liberia's National Flag Day Cadet Corps Drill competition, which featured 29 participating schools.
data.summary: From coordinated marching formations to ceremonial parades, Gray D. Allison's cadet drill activities represent teamwork, discipline, and commitment.

data.title: A Tradition of Academic Achievement
data.content: In September 2026, the Ministry of National Defense reported a 100% WASSCE pass rate for Gray D. Allison High School.
data.summary: Celebrating the dedication of students, teachers, and administrators whose achievements continue to strengthen the school's academic record.
